vulnerability.name: USN-7889-1
vulnerability.description: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems:   - Media drivers;   - Network drivers;   - Netfilter;   - TLS protocol; (CVE-2025-21729, CVE-2025-38227, CVE-2025-38616, CVE-2025-38678)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in the Linux kernel.
